motifs: Sunny / Clear: The sun shines brightly with little to no cloud cover
Partially Cloudy: The sky features a mix of sunshine and scattered clouds
Cloudy / Overcast: A thick blanket of clouds covers most or all of the sky
Rainy: Liquid water droplets fall steadily from the clouds
Drizzle: Very light, fine rain falling in small drops
Stormy (Thunderstorm): Rain accompanied by thunder, lightning, and strong gusts
Snowy: Frozen precipitation in the form of snowflakes falls to the ground
Sleet / Ice Pellets: Frozen or semi-frozen raindrops that bounce upon impact
Hail: Balls or lumps of ice dropping from severe thunderstorms
Windy: Sustained or strong breezes that make outdoor objects move
Breezy: Mild, light, and comfortable air movement
Foggy: Tiny water droplets suspended in the air at ground level, reducing visibility
Mist: A lighter form of fog with slightly better visibility
Humid: Warm air holding a high amount of moisture, making the air feel heavy or sticky
Dry: Low moisture and humidity levels in the atmosphere
Hot / Heatwave: Abnormally high and sustained ambient temperatures
Freezing / Cold: Low temperatures near or well below the freezing point of water
Tornado: A violently rotating column of air extending from a thunderstorm to the ground
Hurricane / Cyclone: A massive, rotating storm system with high-speed winds originating over warm ocean waters
Blizzard / Snowstorm: Heavy falling snow combined with fierce, blinding winds
